chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Songs selected for Ella from Rust's discography
summary: Welburn reads titles like "Spring Fever Blues" and McRae confirms they were chosen for her.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Well, let me go down at least a partial list from Rust's discography -- songs that Ella sang with the band.
And you're talking about some of the songs were mediocre and Jack Robbins made the change. How about songs like "A Little Bit Later On?"
All those songs were picked for her.
"Love, You're Just A Laugh?"
"Love, You're Just A Laugh".
"Devoting My Time" --
"Devoting My Time" was a big song with her too.
"If You Can't Sing It" --
